# oxide_anti_affinity_group_members (Data Source)

Retrieve all members of a specified anti-affinity group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_anti_affinity_group_members" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "my-group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the anti-affinity group.
- `project_name` (String) Name of the project that contains the anti-affinity group.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `members` (Attributes List) Members of the anti-affinity group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the member.
- `name` (String) Name of the member.
- `run_state` (String) Running state of the member.
- `type` (String) Type of the member (e.g. instance).
